players.product: NovaSeq sequencing, BioInsight, and Billion Cell Atlas multi-omics data

quarterly_data.signal: Revenue was $1.16 billion, up 9.5% year over year. More than 95 NovaSeq X systems were placed, instrument revenue rose 31% to $125 million and clinical consumables grew 15% outside China, including more than 20% growth in the U.S. and Canada.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue $1.16B (+9.5%); >95 NovaSeq X placements; instrument revenue $125M (+31%)

quarterly_data.signal: The Billion Cell Atlas delivered 300 million cells and signed six pharmaceutical partners. Management said the program has begun recognizing revenue and is producing perturbation data intended to support AI-enabled drug discovery.

NovaSeq X represented 83% of high-throughput volume and 59% of high-throughput revenue, while total gigabase output increased 30%. Full-year reported revenue guidance was raised to $4.60-$4.64 billion; cash was $1.17 billion and free cash flow was $162 million.
